|lore=Assassins are highly valued by Jabba the Hutt and other gangsters. Ket Maliss, Prince Xizor’s “shadow killer,” has unknown but undoubtedly lethal business in Mos Eisley.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Unless Emperor Palpatine on table, Black Sun agents are defense value +1 and forfeit +2. Once per turn, may take Beedo, Dannik Jerriko, Greedo, Hem Dazon, or Reegesk into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your deploy phase, may deploy a docking bay from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
